title: Running view follow-ups: error marker, stale runs not live, detail order, stopped role, empty golden, other tabs on Running

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S110 relay (2026-10-26). (1) The Running view drops the error marker of a running engine run: rows() sets kindError but only the detail line shows it. (2) liveRunCount (internal/tui/overview.go) counts stale relay runs as live in the Running badge and heading. (3) The detail line orders heard before round; the row shows the bar's rN then heard. (4) selectJumpRun (internal/tui/waves.go) should index m.cursorRows(); unreachable today. (5) A stopped row should show the role it stopped on. (6) No golden for the selected-but-empty Running view. (7) Define what Questions, Waves, Roadmap and Decisions show while the Running entry is selected. (8) The alert glyph sits against the project name (?DataBall); consider a colour or bold cue. Owner decided 2026-10-26: at 100x30 the activity sparkline drops before the pipeline (as S110 does).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestRunningRowKeepsErrorMarker; TestLiveRunCountIgnoresStaleRelayRuns (ledger-only runs; engine-linked runs follow the engine state); TestRunningDetailOrdersRoundBeforeHeard; TestSelectJumpRunUsesCursorRows; TestStoppedRowShowsItsRole; TestRunningSelectedEmptyGolden; TestRunningEntryTabsShowAllProjects (Questions, Waves, Roadmap and Decisions list every project's items with a project prefix while Running is selected); TestAlertGlyphHasAGapAndWarnStyle; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor each of the eight Why items from the code after S110, S138 and S145 (some may be fixed: say so). Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (interactive): while the Running entry is selected, Questions, Waves, Roadmap and Decisions show all projects combined with the project name as a prefix, like Needs you; the alert glyph is amber bold with a space before the project name (mono keeps glyph and space). Earlier: at 100x30 the sparkline drops before the pipeline. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui (and the packages named in Files); goldens (go test ./internal/tui -update, review the diff); go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
